facts.text: Undergraduates are required to attend chapel services held three times per week at 10:00 a.m. in fall and spring as a condition for graduation.

sources.title: Spiritual Life | Dallas Baptist University
sources.quote: Services are offered Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 10:00 a.m. in the Fall and Spring semesters. Chapel is a required aspect of the DBU undergraduate experience and is necessary for graduation.
